info.title: &bookme present API - Production endpoints
info.description: SalesForce API endpoints for creating powerpoints from templates

get.summary:
Downloads the content behind contentRef. A ref recorded as a standalone
template is served as a .pptx attachment; anything else is served as an unlabeled binary,
because its type cannot be established here (see the note in the body). Auth-gated
(TenancyMiddleware rejects unauthenticated callers → 401) and org-scoped: a contentRef belonging
to another organization is denied by contentStore isolation and surfaced as 404 (no existence
leak).

The slide deck for a reference, or 404 when the advisor has not started one. The 404 is
meaningful: it is how the composer tells "nothing here, apply the step-1 defaults" from "a
deck the advisor deliberately emptied", which must not be re-seeded.

put.summary:
Creates or updates the slide deck for a reference. Send `version` as the value last
read (omitted on the first write); a mismatch means someone else has saved since and is
refused with 409 so their work survives and the advisor can be told.

get.summary: Get every tag available for mapping, for the tag picker, with the templates that use each.
Get all templates for the current bank, optionally filtered by labels.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Optional list of label names to filter by. Only templates that have all specified labels will be returned.

get.summary: Get a single template by ID with full details including sections and slides.

patch.summary: Update the labels on a template.

requestBody.description: The labels to set on the template

patch.summary:
Move a template to the given display position; all of the bank's templates are renumbered
contiguously. Standalone (CRM-free) banks only: CRM banks reorder through the CRM
integration and get 409 here.

requestBody.description: The 0-based display position to move the template to

post.summary:
Creates a template in blob storage from a file input.
This assumes that the files Isn't already created in CRM, so this will also upload and create entities in CRM.
This endpoint is the entry point used by the MGMT UI to upload templates

Uploads a template to blob storage, where the content already exists in CRM
This endpoint is the entry point used by the salesforce package

Validates a template and returns translatable results with status codes and interpolation parameters.
Use this endpoint when you need to display validation messages in the user's language.

id.description: Client-generated stable id for the point, used to keep slides attached across edits.

slides.description: The slides under this point, in presentation order.

AgendaPointDto.description: One agenda point, its sub-points, and the slides chosen under it.

contentId.description:
CRM ContentVersion id, populated by the Slides/Generate CRM path. Non-null: the only
producer refuses the request before returning when it is absent. It was widened to nullable
solely for the Slides/Save response, which no longer exists.

GetAllTagsResponse.description:
An available tag, for the tag picker. Mirrors the crm-integration shape, plus the templates
that use the tag.
            
BookmePresent.Api.Models.PresentTagDto carries the same list, but one entry per MAPPING — which answers
nothing for a standalone bank, whose mappings live in its entity pattern and leave no mapping
row behind. This endpoint is keyed on the tag itself, so it answers for every tag the bank has.

name.description: The name of the modifier as used in tag syntax (e.g., "capitalize", "uppercase")

ITagModifier.description:
Interface for tag modifiers that can transform tag values during processing.
Modifiers are applied in sequence and can be chained together.

contentRef.description:
Standalone-mode (CRM-free) contentStore reference for the template payload — the stable fileRef.
Null for CRM-mode templates. Additive and nullable.

PresentTemplateDetailsDto.description: Detailed DTO for Template entity (includes sections/slides).

contentRef.description:
Standalone-mode (CRM-free) contentStore reference for the template payload — the stable fileRef.
Null for CRM-mode templates. Additive and nullable.

PresentTemplateDto.description: DTO for Template (excludes sections/slides for lightweight responses).

version.description:
The version the caller last read, or null when creating the deck for the first time. A
mismatch against the stored version is a 409: someone else has written since.

generated.description:
Set when this write accompanies a generate, stamping `LastGeneratedAt`. Omitted or
false leaves the existing marker alone.

schemaVersion.description:
Contract version. Bumped when the shape changes incompatibly, so a stored deck written by an
older client stays readable rather than silently mis-parsed.

agendaPoints.description:
The agenda, in the order the advisor arranged it. Capped: with the validation filter applied
[MaxLength] validates ICollection.Count, so a runaway client cannot land an unbounded
document in jsonb that every later GET must re-parse. Far above any real agenda.

SlideDeckPayload.description:
The versioned wire and storage contract for a BookmePresent.Database.Models.SlideDeck. Owned by
this service, not mirrored from the composer's view models: engage-web may reshape its internals
freely as long as it keeps producing this.

version.description: Pass back as BookmePresent.Api.Models.SaveSlideDeckRequest.Version on the next write.

SlideDeckResponse.description: A slide deck as served to the composer.

SlideDeckSlideDto.description:
A chosen slide, identified the way the generate wire already identifies one. Deliberately not
the composer's display id, which carries " (2)" suffixes assigned in catalog-fetch order and
therefore drifts when templates are added or reordered.

contentRef.description:
Standalone-mode (CRM-free) contentStore reference for the uploaded template payload — the stable
fileRef. Null for CRM-mode banks, which continue to resolve content through the
frozen Salesforce/CRM path. Additive and nullable so existing CRM responses are unchanged.

name.description: The name of the tag, e.g., "title", "author", "date"

modifiers.description:
List of modifiers to be applied to this tag during processing.
Modifiers are applied in the order they appear in this list.

rawModifiers.description:
Raw modifier strings from the original tag syntax.
Used for validation and debugging purposes.

tags.description:
Names of the tags (placeholders) scoped to this slide, projected from the Slide entity's
Tags navigation. Lets the composer scope which placeholders belong to which slide. Additive
and defaults to empty; serialized as camelCase 'tags'.

UpdateTemplateLabelsInput.description: Input model for updating template labels.

order.description: The 0-based display position to move the template to. Positions past the end move it last.

UpdateTemplateOrderInput.description: Input model for updating a template's display order.
